Ankita Bhandari Case: Complaint Filed Against Pulkit Arya's Father

A police complaint has been filed against Vinod Arya, the father of Pulkit Arya, who is an accused in the Ankita Bhandari case. The parents of Ankita Bhandari have demanded that Vinod Arya undergo a narco test. They reached Matru Sadan in Haridwar to raise this demand.
